name: Phenetrazine
summary: A rare phenethylamine stimulant related to 3-FPM. There is limited information on the drugs pharmacology and effects. It is suspected to have similar properties to structurally similar compounds. Caution is recommended to not confuse it with phenmetrazine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.en: It has no medical use and has appeared as a designer drug.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，曾以設計藥物的形式出現。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，曾以设计药物的形式出现。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: It is related to 3-FPM, one of a set of phenylmorpholine stimulants that reappeared in the research chemical trade in the 2010s, decades after the originals were sold as diet pills.
fact.zh: 它與 3-FPM 相關，屬於 2010 年代重新出現在研究用化學品市場的苯基嗎啉類興奮劑；它們的原型早在數十年前就作為減肥藥販售。
fact.zhHans: 它与 3-FPM 相关，属于 2010 年代重新出现在研究用化学品市场的苯基吗啉类兴奋剂；它们的原型早在数十年前就作为减肥药贩售。
